creatures.name: Glip
creatures.made_of: static-charged lint and a single lost earring back
creatures.gross_or_silly_habit: collects and polishes other creatures' shed fluff into tiny, useless statues
creatures.scared_of: sudden loud noises, especially the microwave beep
creatures.says_when_it_panics: Static's frizzing! The air's got teeth!
creatures.says_when_happy: Ooh, crisp! I love the hum of the fridge!
creatures.secretly_brilliant_at: navigating by magnetic fields and fixing broken cable cars with spit and hope

creatures.name: Dustbert
creatures.made_of: old socks, lint, and forgotten pizza crumbs
creatures.gross_or_silly_habit: always has a half-eaten pizza crust stuck to his back
creatures.says_when_it_panics: Not the vacuum! I'm not ready to be sucked up yet!
creatures.says_when_happy: Pizza time! Who's ready for a party?
creatures.secretly_brilliant_at: remembering where everyone's lost items are hidden

creatures.name: Glimmerfluff
creatures.made_of: Shimmering dust and tiny, glittery feathers
creatures.gross_or_silly_habit: Flutters around in a cloud of glittery dust
creatures.says_when_it_panics: Giggles nervously and tries to fly away
creatures.secretly_brilliant_at: Creating beautiful, intricate patterns with its glittery feathers

creatures.name: Sproutling
creatures.made_of: dust bunnies, crumpled paper, and dried glue
creatures.gross_or_silly_habit: collects random shiny objects and hoards them in a nest made of old socks
creatures.scared_of: sudden loud noises, especially the sound of a vacuum cleaner
creatures.says_when_happy: This is the best day ever, isn't it?
creatures.secretly_brilliant_at: remembering hidden paths and shortcuts through the room

creatures.name: Gloop
creatures.made_of: melted crayon wax and leftover cereal bits
creatures.gross_or_silly_habit: sucks up dust particles with its gooey body to make 'gloop soup' for breakfast
creatures.scared_of: being left alone in the dark
creatures.says_when_it_panics: WHOOOAAAAA! I'm gonna get stuck in a crack!
creatures.secretly_brilliant_at: calculating the exact angle to slide down a cable car rope without falling off

creatures.name: Gloop
creatures.gross_or_silly_habit: collects lint balls and makes them into a nest

creatures.name: Tacky
creatures.made_of: a dried-out yellow highlighter cap fused to a wad of old, brown, fossilized chewing gum
creatures.gross_or_silly_habit: sneezes out tiny translucent gum balls that stick to every surface it touches, including the player's phone screen
creatures.says_when_it_panics: THE ROLLER! THE ROLLER IS EATING ME! I'M JUST A LITTLE GUM BALL!
creatures.says_when_happy: I'M STICKY AND I'M PROUD OF IT! WHEEE!
creatures.secretly_brilliant_at: negotiating tiny peace treaties between the other Fluffkins

creatures.name: Grizzle
creatures.made_of: Dried moss and discarded bottle caps
creatures.gross_or_silly_habit: Constantly sheds moss flakes, leaving a green trail everywhere.
creatures.scared_of: Sudden, bright lights; they make his moss brittle.
creatures.secretly_brilliant_at: Calculating structural integrity of Fluffkin constructions.

creatures.name: Glimmerfluff
creatures.made_of: Shimmering dust and tiny, iridescent feathers
creatures.gross_or_silly_habit: Flutters its feathers in a silly dance when excited
creatures.says_when_it_panics: Giggles nervously and starts spinning in circles
creatures.says_when_happy: Sings a cheerful tune and twirls around
creatures.secretly_brilliant_at: Creating dazzling light displays and solving puzzles
